title: Keep an event in its place in time
communicates: When events begin and end, and which intervals overlap.
observation: ValueTracker supports a changing numerical value driving an animation.
interpretation: Use one shared time value and preserve the intervals needed to compare overlap. Keep entity identities consistent with the surrounding system; disclose secondary history rather than accumulating it on screen. The timeline is our adaptation, not a copied Manim example.
avoid: Animating a future event as if it already happened.
Resetting a completed event on every frame.
Changing an established symbol’s meaning to fit this pattern.
Choosing this pattern merely because a source paragraph can be animated.
